name: MCP (dot-do)
description: A framework that provides search, fetch, and do primitives to enable AI agents to orchestrate complex tasks via sandboxed TypeScript code execution. It optimizes performance and security by reducing multiple sequential tool calls into a single, efficient inference round-trip.
